reading.title: Libra Sun Fallen, Neptune-Pluto Sextile
overview: The Sun at 16° Libra in fall shares the sign with the Moon at 6° Libra while Mercury stands at 11° Scorpio and Venus at 8° Scorpio retrograde in detriment. Mars at 7° Leo forms a square to Venus and a sextile to Uranus at 5° Gemini retrograde; the outer planets show Neptune at 3° Aries retrograde sextile Pluto at 3° Aquarius retrograde out of bounds, with Uranus trine Pluto.

Mundane tradition reads the Neptune-Pluto sextile as slow shifts in collective belief and the Venus-Mars square as alliances strained by force or weapons spending. Mars sextile Uranus points to sudden attacks or technical warfare, while Saturn at 11° Aries retrograde in fall and the Sun's conjunction to the US natal Saturn mark periods of institutional pressure.

The last new moon at Virgo 18° fell in the fourth house for the United States and the first house for Russia, Ukraine and Israel, placing Mars in the second or eleventh and Saturn in the eleventh or eighth according to each capital's whole-sign houses.

nations.reading: Transiting Saturn trines the Sibly ASC while Neptune opposes the MC and squares natal Venus; the Sun conjoins natal Saturn. These contacts coincide with sanctions on the ICC and posters framing Iranian forces as the newest threat, though the records show no reliable link between such transits and measurable events.

Neptune squares the natal Sun while Jupiter trines the MC and Saturn trines natal Mercury. Reporting on Russian strikes and energy-truce demands overlaps these degrees, yet the fair tests found Mars afflictions and full moons no better than chance against personnel-loss and alert data.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Saturn squares natal Uranus. Coverage of espionage allegations and continued strikes sits near these contacts, but the same statistical tests returned results indistinguishable from random variation over thousands of days.

Pluto opposes natal Moon while Saturn opposes natal Neptune and the Sun sextiles natal Saturn. These positions align with regional threat reporting, yet the records show Mars afflictions and lunations produce no measurable elevation in rocket-alert frequency.

reading.lore_and_intel: Neptune sextile Pluto, Venus square Mars, Mars sextile Uranus and Mars opposition Pluto appear in reporting on Iranian-threat posters, US-Korea defense polls, Austrian espionage claims and Middle-East strike speculation, with z-values from 3.4 to 6.4; Uranus trine Pluto and Uranus sextile Neptune touch Eritrean-troop and energy-truce items. No computed overlap exists with the listed transits for China, Taiwan or North Korea beyond the general outer-planet aspects, and the fair tests found none of the traditional war or alert signals exceeded chance.

reading.the_test: Mars afflictions produced war-related alerts versus Ukraine, Israel and Russian losses at -1 % to +2 % above chance (p-values 0.58-0.82, all corrected to 1.00) across 1654-3870 days. Full moons yielded +6 % to +35 % (p 0.09-0.24, corrected 0.56-1.00). The records therefore show these astrological claims perform no better than chance.
